verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS evaluation and observability platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question, but the evidence pack contains no documented API spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
